La décoction de Siriena préserve une matière organique allant jusqu'à la taille d'un corps pendant environ une heure. This grass is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains hard to find.

A Siriena decoction preserves organic matter up to the size of a body for approximately one hour. This preservative effect must be distinguished from remedies that repair living tissue. Despite its short duration, repeated administrations may lead to substantial habituation.
